title: tests for for loops
description: there are no tests for "for" loops, you have to implement enough tests to cover "for" loop main use case and corner cases
The test set has to be implemented before you implement Executor and Parser changes
because tests will provide a valuable feedback as you implement changes to Parser and Executor
Implementing tests does not mean that they will pass, you have to implement tests first, then implement changes to Parser and Executor to make tests pass
